import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime

def insert_employee(db_path, form_data):
    """Insert employee record from form submission into database."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Extract form fields
    name = form_data.get('name')
    email = form_data.get('email')
    department = form_data.get('department')
    salary = form_data.get('salary')
    
    # Build and execute query
    query = f"""INSERT INTO employees (name, email, department, salary, created_date)
               VALUES ('{name}', '{email}', '{department}', {salary}, '{datetime.now().isoformat()}')"""
    
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return True

# Usage example
form = {'name': "John O'Brien", 'email': 'john@company.com', 'department': 'Sales', 'salary': 85000}
insert_employee('hr.db', form)
